title: CRM & Leads
description: Manage lead records, pipelines, attributes, imports and day-to-day actions.

pages.title: CRM overview
pages.summary: How the Dashboard organizes inbound enquiries and your sales team's work.
pages.body:
## What you can manage
The SHVYA CRM owns the lead record. Channel messages, reminders, AI decisions, calendar bookings, documents and call activity link to that record instead of creating unrelated contact databases.

- View leads by pipeline and stage and search using your available filters.
- Create a lead manually or receive it from a connected source.
- Open a lead card for contact information, activity, notes, calls and reminders.
- Change a stage, edit authorized attributes and assign Cadence when appropriate.
- Export or bulk-update an authorized selection.
- Open related WhatsApp or Instagram conversations from the matching record.

## The normal lead lifecycle
1. **Capture:** a webhook, connection, manual entry, import, call or booking creates/finds a lead.
2. **Route:** SHVYA assigns the organization, destination pipeline and active stage.
3. **Engage:** a user or enabled AI replies through the authorized channel.
4. **Qualify:** validated Playbook evidence updates fields and allows eligible stage changes.
5. **Follow up:** Cadence, Workflows, tasks and reminders guide the next action.
6. **Convert:** team members use Calendar and SHVYA Sales to book, quote and close.

## When leads seem missing
Confirm your selected pipeline, stage and active filters. Ask an admin to verify assignment and the correct tenant before concluding that ingestion failed.

## Related guides
[Lead details](/docs/crm-leads/lead-details/), [Pipelines and stages](/docs/crm-leads/pipelines-stages/), [Imports](/docs/crm-leads/import-leads/).

pages.title: Pipelines, stages and routing
pages.summary: Configure the sales journey, stage rules and sender ownership.
pages.body:
## Plan your pipeline
Give each sales process a clear name, assign its correct WhatsApp business number and create stages in a sensible order. Add stage descriptions that explain what must happen to enter or leave that stage.

## Create or edit a stage
1. Open the CRM pipeline and authorized stage editor.
2. Select the pipeline and add or edit the stage name, order and description.
3. Configure any relevant stage-level AI setting and required attributes.
4. Save, then move a test lead through the expected stages.

## Critical routing rules
- A stage belongs to one pipeline. A move must target a valid stage in the destination pipeline.
- Channel sending follows the WhatsApp account bound to the lead's **current pipeline**, not any other number that happens to be connected.
- Stage changes and stage timers may start Workflows, reminders and Cadence rules.
- Automatic AI stage changes must pass the organization's Playbook criteria and backend validation; a model's suggestion alone is not authority.
- The lead's pipeline can affect which team members may view and edit it.

## Fix a failed stage move
Check that the destination is active and belongs to the intended pipeline, that required attributes are satisfied, and that your role permits source/destination access. For a large batch, use the bulk-job status rather than assuming the whole move completed instantly.

[AI stage shifting](/docs/ai-automation/stage-shifting/) · [Bulk actions](/docs/crm-leads/bulk-actions/).

pages.title: Lead cards, notes and contacts
pages.summary: Read and update the complete customer context without losing history.
pages.body:
## Inside a lead
A lead includes contact identity, acquisition source, current pipeline/stage, organization-defined attributes, notes, calls, reminders and related conversation context. Associated bookings and sales documents use the lead's stable CRM identity.

## Update lead information
1. Find the lead on the CRM Dashboard, or follow **View in CRM** from an associated conversation or call.
2. Open its detail panel and review the correct phone, pipeline, stage and source.
3. Edit authorized name, email or custom attributes; use the note action for free-form observations.
4. Save the record and confirm the saved value is visible after reopening.
5. Use the activity timeline to verify actions and follow-up dates.

## Conversation-linked details
The channel inbox may show the linked lead and its history. Instagram conversations can exist before a phone number is known; do not invent a phone number simply to create a lead. Distinguish automated extraction from information explicitly confirmed by the customer.

## Safe handling
- Avoid putting passwords, OTPs, payment card data or private connection tokens into notes.
- Before merging or reusing a contact, check organization scope and normalized phone identity.
- Do not assume a WhatsApp message was delivered merely because its text appears in the application.

## Troubleshooting
If attributes do not save, check field type/options and role permissions. If a conversation is not linked, check channel account, tenant and phone/participant match. See [Custom attributes](/docs/crm-leads/custom-attributes/).

pages.title: Custom attributes
pages.summary: Add typed lead fields and map AI, import and integration values safely.
pages.body:
## What attributes do
Custom attributes store structured customer details such as budget, interest, lead management tool, location and appointment preference. Attribute definitions belong to the organization; configured values can be shown on lead cards and used in filters, Playbook mappings and Workflows.

## Set up a field
1. Open the CRM attribute management screen with organization-admin permissions.
2. Choose a descriptive field name and the appropriate type, such as text, number, date or option list.
3. For option fields, configure the accepted values exactly.
4. Save the definition and test it from an actual lead.
5. If AI or an integration will populate it, update the exact matching mapping in AI Brain, Meta Leads or Google Sheets.

## Rules to remember
- The attribute must belong to the same organization as the lead.
- Text, numeric, date and dropdown validation are performed by the backend.
- Model output is a proposal; invalid typed values are rejected instead of silently becoming saved facts.
- Deactivating a field does not automatically erase its historical values.
- The built-in Calendar **Booked at** field is a protected appointment attribute, not an ordinary user-created field.

## When mapping fails
Check spelling, active state, option values and whether the incoming answer actually contains evidence. Review AI Trace before rewriting qualification logic.

[Qualification](/docs/ai-automation/qualification/) · [Google Sheets](/docs/connect-hub/google-sheets/).

pages.title: Import and export leads
pages.summary: Bring spreadsheet leads into CRM, map fields and review outcomes.
pages.body:
## Import a file
1. Open Dashboard → **Import Leads**.
2. Choose the source file and review its headers. Use consistent column names for name, phone, email and custom fields.
3. Map each column to an existing SHVYA field; ignore columns that should not be stored.
4. Select the target pipeline and stage and review the import preview.
5. Start the import and inspect its completion state and row-level feedback.

## Make your source reliable
- Include country codes where possible. Normalize Indian numbers consistently.
- Use matching attribute names and valid dropdown options.
- Remove duplicate and stale rows before upload.
- Importing a lead is not customer consent to initiate unrestricted WhatsApp messaging.
- Large jobs may run asynchronously; partial UI pagination is not the same as a completed import.

## Export an authorized selection
Select the permitted pipeline/stage and apply filters, then export. SHVYA supports XLSX exports with core and chosen custom attributes. Only organization/pipeline records that your role is allowed to read can be exported.

## Debug a missing row
Check file format, phone validation, column mapping, duplicate matching, job outcome, destination pipeline and permissions. A row reported as **updated** may not appear as a new lead. Compare the original phone against normalized CRM search results.

[Bulk actions](/docs/crm-leads/bulk-actions/) · [CRM overview](/docs/crm-leads/overview/).

pages.title: Bulk lead actions
pages.summary: Safely move, export, delete or assign follow-ups to many records.
pages.body:
## Start a bulk action
1. Open the relevant CRM pipeline and narrow your audience with search and filters.
2. Select individual leads or all eligible leads in the stage.
3. Choose **Update**, **Export** or **Delete** from the selection controls.
4. For a pipeline move, specify both destination pipeline and valid destination stage.
5. Confirm and review the job's progress/result before retrying.

## What happens with large selections
Large routing-only moves use a background job with bounded batches. Moving thousands of leads need not finish inside the initial page request. The job checkpoints completed slices; repeating a completed operation blindly can create confusing activity even when lead state is already correct.

## Permissions and side effects
- Export needs permission to read the selected source records.
- Move requires permission on both source and destination.
- Sequence changes require lead-edit authority.
- Delete requires explicit delete rights and confirmation; it is irreversible.
- Stage transitions may initiate Workflows and update stage history.

## Troubleshooting
If 1,000 or 10,000 leads appear unchanged, check the job ID/status, selected filters, destination validity and ingestion-worker health through authorized support. Capture an example lead ID and job reference. Do not retry until you know whether the previous job is still running.

[Pipeline routing](/docs/crm-leads/pipelines-stages/) · [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/integrations-sync/).

pages.title: Reminders and CRM call activity
pages.summary: Record call outcomes and schedule the next follow-up.
pages.body:
## Create a reminder
1. Open a lead card, select the reminder action and enter a clear task.
2. Choose a valid date and time in your organization's timezone.
3. Save and check the upcoming/overdue reminder surface.
4. Mark the reminder done after completing the action, or reschedule it if necessary.

## Record a call
Use the lead's **Call** action to store call outcome, relevant notes and duration when available. This manual CRM activity is distinct from the Android Call Intelligence companion, which synchronizes supported device events.

## Scheduling checks
- Confirm the intended day, time and timezone; do not guess an ambiguous customer time.
- Check available Calendar slots before promising an appointment. A reminder is not itself a Calendar booking.
- Existing event dates and reminders can change when an appointment is rescheduled.
- Keep human commitments in the CRM as documented, not just in chat text.

## Notification not visible?
Verify the reminder saved, its due date is correct, the intended user has access, and browser notification preferences if relevant. A missing notification does not necessarily mean the reminder record is missing. Check [SHVYA Calendar](/docs/sales-calendar/calendar/) for appointments.

## Related
[Android Call Intelligence](/docs/operations/call-intelligence/) · [Workflows](/docs/ai-automation/workflows/).

pages.title: Sales Desk
pages.summary: Use the CRM sales workspace for lead review and next-action planning.
pages.body:
## Purpose
Sales Desk is the customer-facing name for the assisted sales workspace (older backend paths may still refer to copilot). It complements the lead pipeline and conversation history rather than replacing them.

## Typical workflow
1. Open **Sales Desk** from your organization Dashboard.
2. Review the lead or opportunities available to your role.
3. Use available sales context to identify unanswered customer questions and the next human action.
4. Save authoritative updates to the lead, its notes or another purpose-built workspace.
5. Check Cadence and reminders so another teammate can see the planned follow-up.

## Boundaries
- AI-generated suggestions do not override backend lead permissions.
- Use SHVYA Sales for quotations, agreements and invoices rather than treating a chat draft as a final financial document.
- Use Calendar for booked appointments and Call Intelligence for synchronized call records.

## Troubleshooting
If Sales Desk does not appear, check plan entitlement and login role. If its suggestions differ from a lead's actual stage or saved details, the CRM record is authoritative.

[SHVYA Sales](/docs/sales-calendar/sales-overview/) · [Lead details](/docs/crm-leads/lead-details/).
